source.name: Mars 2020 Terrain Relative Navigation CTX DTM Mosaic
source.license: CC0 1.0 / USGS data release; cite the authors
source.native_projection: Mars equirectangular/equidistant cylindrical, latitude of true scale 0°, central longitude 0°, sphere radius 3,396,190 m
source.control: Horizontally/vertically controlled to MOLA; USGS terrain-relative-navigation CTX mosaic

terrain_model.terrain_cost_method: linear clamp of p90 slope: 0 at <=5 deg, 1 at >=25 deg
terrain_model.passability_method: exclude cells with insufficient elevation coverage, missing p90 slope, or p90 slope > 25 deg
terrain_model.route_speed_note: Travel time remains a configurable illustrative walking-speed model; it is not a NASA EVA operational standard.
